This folder contains third-party dependency entry points and submodule
references used by the PyTorch tree.

It is not the complete third-party source delivery for Hygon PyTorch source
release.

For Hygon PyTorch source releases, actual build may remove this repository copy
of `third_party/` and replace it with a matched standalone third-party source
bundle before compilation. See ../THIRD_PARTY_BUNDLE.md for the current bundle
information, extraction path, and compliance notes.

The complete third-party source delivery, including full license texts,
attribution materials, and modified third-party library sources, is expected to
be provided by the matched standalone third-party bundle rather than this
repository copy.
